subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil designer or engineer, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your careers page invites people who want to work with Axiom to upload a CV, so I wanted to introduce myself.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your Maddingly Village work near Bacchus Marsh, from earthworks, drainage and pavement design through to Superintendent on site, is the mix of design and construction I want to learn. My drafting so far is from study rather than a paid Australian role.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate civil design or engineering opening, now or later? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil designer or engineer
paragraphs: I would like to ask whether Axiom Consulting Engineers has room for a graduate civil designer or engineer. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advertised role, sent through your careers page because it invites people who want to work with you to get in touch.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

Your Maddingly Village project near Bacchus Marsh, where Axiom designed the earthworks, stormwater drainage and road pavements and then acted as Superintendent during construction, is the mix of design and site work I want to build my career in. I live in Melton and hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, with full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My design experience is from study rather than a paid Australian role, so I would value the chance to learn from your team.
I have attached my resume. Thank you for considering my enquiry.

checklist: Open https://www.axiomconsultingengineers.com.au/careers and use the 'Want to work with us?' upload form (max 15MB).
Upload the resume and this cover letter from the record's attachments (one PDF each, or merge them if the form takes one file).
If the form has a message box, paste the short message on this record (it is labelled as a speculative enquiry).
Do not email admin@axiomce.com.au with the same pack; the careers form is the employer's own channel.
After submitting, press Applied on this record with the date; note any acknowledgement.
notes: SPECULATIVE_ENQUIRY. SEEK sweeps at 3, 7 and 14 days (60 then 80 details) plus the councils and government rotation found no new junior adverts that cleared screening (all duplicates of tracked employers or 3+ years, degree-plus-experience, student-only or citizenship/PR roles), so this is the runbook's one speculative enquiry. Axiom careers page read 12 Oct 2026 AEDT shows no vacancy and an upload form. Ballarat is about an hour from Melton, so no relocation is implied.
